audit.reasoning: The classification fixed-strict penultimate (penultimate stress) rests on a 435-pp modern reference grammar by the fieldworker, held held by the project, with the deciding quotation verified verbatim at the stated pages; Sato explicitly says the rule is exceptionless and applies at word level across morpheme boundaries, matching classification fixed-strict, in the dominant set, domain=word. No better or competing stress source exists. Two housekeeping points, neither changing the classification: (a) the record's grade field is blank although the evidence is primary and verified — fill it; the the secondary-stress rule field could also carry Sato's secondary-stress statement (every second syllable leftward of the penult).
